quote: Each tuple annotation generates five pair-wise comparisons between questions' intimacy values that act as constraints when inferring the latent value on a continuous scale. Prior to annotation, two annotators went through three rounds of training and discussed all disagreements.
guideline: Annotators were asked to choose the question that could "lead to the Most/Least INTIMATE, DEEP and PERSONAL response in the APPROPRIATE SETTING" among four randomly selected questions.
